title: 8-Day Athens & Petra Two-Country Journey
metaTitle: Athens & Petra in 8 Days | Greece Jordan Tour
metaDescription: Combine Athens, Amman and Petra in 8 days, connecting Classical Greece with Jordan's ancient capital and the remarkable Nabataean city of Petra.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 8-Day Greece & Jordan Tour links the classical heritage of Athens with Jordan’s archaeological heartland. Begin in Athens with guided visits to its ancient landmarks before continuing to Amman. From the Jordanian capital, travel south to Petra, where the Nabataean city provides the main archaeological focus of the journey. The itinerary keeps the route centered on two countries and three principal destinations rather than adding Greek islands or Jordan’s desert camps.
The escorted program operates from April to October, with selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, professional local guides, entrance fees, airport transfers and land transportation included throughout the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Athens City tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Start a city tour of Athens, including visits to the Acropolis of Athens, the Acropolis Museum, and the famous Parthenon. Continue to see the Hellenic Parliament, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, and the National Library. Visit the Presidential Mansion to watch the Evzones Guards, then continue to the Panathenaic Stadium, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Hadrian's Arch. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Saronic Island Cruise
itinerary.text: Transfer to Port of Piraeus for embarkation on the cruise boat. Sail to Hydra and enjoy free time for walking, shopping, or swimming. Continue to Poros with short free time to explore the island. Lunch will be served onboard during the cruise. Sail to Aegina with free time for leisure or swimming, weather permitting. Optional excursion available to visit the Temple of Aphaia. Return to Athens. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Overday Trip to Delphi
itinerary.text: Depart from Athens and drive through the fertile plain of Boeotia, passing Thebes, Livadeia, and the mountain village of Arachova. Continue to the Delphi Archaeological Site. Visit the famous Temple of Apollo and the Treasury of the Athenians before exploring the impressive Delphi Archaeological Museum. After the tour, return to Athens. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Amman By Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to Athens Airport for your flight to Amman.
Arrival at Queen Alia International Airport. Meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Madaba – Mt. Nebo – Dead Sea – Petra
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Drive to Madaba and visit St. George’s Church. Continue to Mount Nebo, the place where Prophet Moses viewed the Promised Land. Visit the monastery and enjoy panoramic views over the Jordan Valley and the Dead Sea. Proceed to the Dead Sea and enjoy free time to float in its mineral-rich waters. Continue to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Petra Visit – Amman Hotel
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Petra, the rose-red city and Jordan’s most famous attraction. Walk through the narrow Siq canyon to reach the stunning Al-Khazneh (Treasury). Continue to the Street of Facades, the Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle. After the tour, drive back to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Amman Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out.
Transfer to Queen Alia International Airport for your return flight home.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Explore Greece & Jordan in 8 Days tour?
faqs.a: The Explore Greece & Jordan in 8 Days tour covers Athens in Greece, along with Amman and Petra in Jordan. This itinerary combines the birthplace of Western civilization with one of the Middle East's most remarkable archaeological destinations, offering a perfect blend of history, culture, and unforgettable sightseeing experiences. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Explore Greece & Jordan in 8 Days tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,795 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and one domestic flight. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, one domestic flight is included within the itinerary. Additional transportation between destinations is provided according to the tour program. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels in Greece and Jordan. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Greece and Jordan. Your guides will provide fascinating insights into the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece and Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors looking for a shorter itinerary that still covers the essential highlights of both countries. It provides an excellent introduction to the history and culture of Greece and Jordan.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historical sites, archaeological areas, and city centers. Petra requires a moderate amount of walking, while most other sightseeing activities are suitable for visitors with average fitness levels.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Acropolis and Parthenon in Athens, the vibrant capital city of Amman, and the spectacular UNESCO World Heritage Site of Petra, famous for its rock-carved monuments, including the iconic Treasury.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Explore Greece & Jordan in 8 Days tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the Explore Greece & Jordan in 8 Days tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include destinations such as Santorini, Mykonos, Wadi Rum, the Dead Sea, or Jerash, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
